  "body_excerpt": "### Summary\n\nHi!\n\nCurrently, vulnerabilities can be ignored through inline arguments `--ignore` and `--ignore-until-fixed` in `uv audit`, but I think this can become (1) cumbersome and is not really (2) explicit in repositories, as these arguments, including their vulnerabilities, are often hidden inside scripts executing `uv audit`.\n\nMost importantly: (3) No one knows **why** the vulnerabilities "
